regressions.H1_target: CLR of annual mean normalized foodservice component
regressions.H2_target: log of mean monthly nominal expenditure divided by regional CPI chain
regressions.primary_p: restricted-null region Rademacher wild cluster bootstrap-t

H3.split: strictly above median sector_C_share within region and municipality type
H3.matching: maximum cardinality, then minimum standardized economic distance; no reuse
H3.inference: one shared random sign per region for all its paired differences
H3.joint_rule: both directed CLR component tests must pass the common Holm family

H4.sample: core_eligible and complete eight observed sector shares
H4.cost: sqrt(0.5*mean(core z differences squared)+0.5*mean(sector z differences squared))
H4.matching: maximum cardinality, then minimum cost; no reuse
H4.inference: shuffle complete five-component profiles within eligible regions; fixed pairs
